qualifier: cerebellar layer formation, motor learning and proprioception
name: Cerebellar development and motor coordination behavior
rationale: Members cover cerebellar cortex formation (granule, Purkinje, Bergmann glia), nigral development, neural RNA regulation and motor behaviors (walking, righting, proprioception, motor learning), which separate it from exploratory/grooming, brainstem/hindbrain, forebrain and glycinergic confusables.

qualifier: kinetochore attachment and spindle checkpoint control
name: Mitotic spindle assembly, kinetochore attachment and checkpoint control
rationale: All members concern building the mitotic spindle, attaching it to kinetochores, midzone assembly and the spindle assembly checkpoint, unlike confusables centred on AURKA/PLK1 mitotic entry, sister chromatid cohesion or cytokinesis.

qualifier: via endocytosis and lysosomal targeting
name: Receptor downregulation by endocytosis and lysosomal targeting
rationale: Members promote receptor internalization, block recycling and surface localization and route proteins to lysosomal degradation, whereas the confusables concern cholesterol and lipoprotein homeostasis rather than receptor trafficking.

qualifier: mesangial and endothelial (vascular) components
name: Glomerular mesangial and endothelial development
rationale: All members concern development of the glomerular mesangium and glomerular vasculature/endothelium, while confusables cover general metanephric proliferation, mesenchyme and tubule development.

qualifier: cytochrome P450 oxidation plus acetylation, methylation and sulfonation
name: Xenobiotic biotransformation by cytochrome P450 oxidation and conjugation
rationale: Members are drug and foreign-compound metabolism through CYP oxidation (CYP1A2, CYP2E1, demethylation, paracetamol) and phase II conjugation, distinct from confusables built on steroid, FMO, toxin or thiopurine metabolism.

qualifier: macrophage cytokine and TGF-beta1 output
name: Regulation of inflammatory and TGF-beta1 cytokine production
rationale: Members control the output of inflammatory cytokines (macrophage cytokines, TNF/IL-23/IL-6 family, IL-37 restraint) and TGF-beta1, rather than downstream signalling of IL-10/IL-27/IL-6-family receptors or myeloid NF-kB activation in the confusables.

qualifier: by deadenylation-dependent mRNA decay
name: miRNA biogenesis and silencing by deadenylation-dependent mRNA decay
rationale: Members span miRNA biogenesis, RISC assembly and miRNA-directed mRNA destabilization via poly(A) shortening and P-bodies, unlike confusables about miRNA turnover, siRNA processing or translational repression of specific transcripts.

Members mix ER/membrane and extracellular compartment gene sets, three promoter-motif sets and unrelated responses to heparin and glycoprotein plus endothelial-matrix adhesion, with no single biological process shared by all.

qualifier: Hox clusters, somitogenesis and limb morphogenesis
name: Hox-driven embryonic axis patterning, somitogenesis and limb morphogenesis
rationale: Members are embryonic body-plan patterning by Hox clusters, somite formation and segmentation, neural plate and hindbrain regionalization and limb/digit/joint morphogenesis, distinguishing it from craniofacial-organ, forebrain and axial-mesoderm/neural-tube confusables.

qualifier: exploration, sensorimotor gating and nonassociative learning
name: Synaptic transmission enhancement in locomotion, exploration and sensorimotor gating
rationale: Members couple enhanced glutamatergic/GABAergic transmission and NCAM1 synaptic interactions with locomotor, exploratory, prepulse-inhibition and habituation behaviors, unlike confusables about dendritic spines, AMPA receptor clustering, amygdala/grooming or neurotrophic signalling.

qualifier: netrin signalling and collateral sprouting
name: Netrin-mediated axon guidance and collateral sprouting
rationale: Members centre on netrin signalling, axon extension control and guidance of dopaminergic, serotonergic and anterior-posterior axons plus collateral sprouting, whereas confusables are semaphorin, ephrin/L1 or Slit-Robo guidance.

qualifier: stress adaptation, sarcomere organization and survival
name: Cardiomyocyte hypertrophic growth, stress adaptation and survival
rationale: Members regulate cardiac muscle adaptation, stress hypertrophy, cardiomyocyte growth, sarcomere organization, regeneration and anti-apoptosis, unlike confusables on cardiomyocyte proliferation, contractility or calcineurin-NFAT cell size.

qualifier: replicase synthesis and mRNA capping
name: Coronavirus replicase synthesis, genome replication and RNA capping
rationale: All members describe the SARS-CoV-1/2 replication programme (replicase translation and maturation, genome replication, cap methylation for IFIT evasion, host translation control), distinct from RSV/influenza and frameshifting confusables.

qualifier: cytochrome P450 omega-hydroxylase and epoxygenase routes
name: Cytochrome P450 omega-hydroxylation and epoxygenation of eicosanoids
rationale: Members are CYP-dependent omega-hydroxylation (20-HETE, LTB4 catabolism) and epoxygenation (EETs) of fatty acids and eicosanoids, unlike confusables on lipoxygenase, leukotriene synthesis or cyclooxygenase prostanoids.

qualifier: promoter escape and CTD-coupled capping, including HIV
name: RNA polymerase II initiation, promoter escape and co-transcriptional capping
rationale: Members cover Pol II pre-initiation, promoter opening and escape, CTD phosphorylation with capping enzyme recruitment and early elongation complex formation (host and HIV), whereas confusables address Tat-dependent elongation and Pol II pausing.

qualifier: ESCRT-III resealing and abscission
name: Mitotic nuclear envelope disassembly, ESCRT-III resealing and abscission
rationale: Members span lamina depolymerization, nuclear envelope breakdown and reformation, ESCRT-III sealing and midbody abscission, unlike confusables on chromosome condensation, SUMOylation or contractile ring cytokinesis.

qualifier: inhibition of proliferation, migration and differentiation
name: Restraint of vascular smooth muscle phenotypic switching
rationale: Members regulate VSMC phenotypic switching and dedifferentiation and negatively regulate VSMC proliferation, migration and differentiation, whereas confusables promote VSMC growth/migration or concern endothelial activation.

qualifier: inherited surfactant dysfunction disorders
name: Pulmonary surfactant metabolism and its genetic deficiencies
rationale: All members concern surfactant homeostasis and its disorders caused by SFTPB, SFTPC, SFTPA2, ABCA3 and GM-CSF receptor defects, unlike lung development or erythrocyte gas transport confusables.

qualifier: ATP synthesis and nucleotide output under stress
name: Mitochondrial respiration and ATP synthesis regulation under cellular stress
rationale: Members regulate oxidative phosphorylation, electron transport, ATP and nucleotide synthesis, PGC-1alpha and mitochondrial depolarization alongside hypoxia, drug and oxidative stress responses, whereas confusables focus on peroxide-induced death and ferroptosis.

core: RNA virus genome replication and expression
qualifier: influenza, RSV and coronavirus
name: Influenza, RSV and coronavirus RNA genome replication and expression
rationale: Members describe RNA virus replication, transcription, RNP trafficking, translation and host-defence evasion for influenza, RSV and SARS-CoV, unlike confusables limited to coronavirus replicase or including HIV/HCMV DNA-stage events.

qualifier: amyloid-beta response and LTP suppression
name: Dendritic spine maintenance and amyloid-beta synaptotoxicity
rationale: Members regulate maintenance of dendritic spines, neuron projections and postsynaptic membrane together with amyloid-beta response and LTP inhibition, unlike reelin-driven dendrite development, plasticity-promoting or behavioral confusables.

qualifier: Rab and ARF GTPase regulation
name: Rab and ARF GTPase control of endocytic recycling
rationale: Members are Rab/ARF GTPase signalling and RabGAPs governing endocytosis, endosome organization, recycling to the plasma membrane, Golgi localization and constitutive secretion, unlike confusables on membrane tubulation, Golgi-lysosome or neuronal receptor trafficking.

qualifier: C-strand fill-in synthesis and end protection
name: Telomere C-strand fill-in synthesis and end protection
rationale: Members cover lagging C-strand synthesis at telomeres, telomere packaging, protein recruitment, recombination inhibition and telomerase restraint, unlike confusables on ALT/ATRX, capping/NHEJ protection or telomerase extension.

qualifier: degron recognition and K48 ubiquitination
name: Proteasomal degradation control: degron recognition and K48 ubiquitination
rationale: Members regulate proteasomal protein turnover via N-end and C-end degrons, K48/auto-ubiquitination, UCH deubiquitinases and ubiquitin-independent degradation, unlike confusables on ribosome quality control, non-K48 chain types or ERAD/misfolded protein handling.

qualifier: type II (SLC34) transporters and their hereditary defects
name: Type II sodium-phosphate cotransport and hypophosphatemic disorders
rationale: All members concern SLC34 type II Na+/Pi cotransporters, their regulation and SLC34A1/A3 hypophosphatemic diseases, distinct from confusables on bone mineralization, PTH and FGF23-Klotho signalling.
